messages: nina: FYI ran the weekly KB scan and noticed a handful of dead anchors in /runtime guide. not urgent but affects some runbook links: `#batching`, `#kv-cache-detail`, and `#autoscale-policy`. link-bot: automated-scan: 3 broken anchor(s) found in /runtime (ids: batching, kv-cache-detail, autoscale-policy). recommended fix: add explicit anchors or restore previous header slugs. omar: can you paste the exact header lines? i'll prep a tiny PR unless someone else wants it. nina: sure — grep output: ``` $ rg "Batching|KV cache|Autoscaling" docs/runtime.md -n 138:# Batching for throughput 209:# KV cache (implementation notes) 299:# Autoscaling — policies and thresholds ``` headers exist but slugger produced different ids after the MDX migration. explicit anchors are safest. jules: i'll take `batching` and `kv-cache-detail`. want them as HTML anchors above headers or as `{#explicit-slug}` MDX style? claudia: runtime guide owner here: prefer HTML anchors so header text stays untouched. i'll review quickly. omar: HTML anchors SGTM. tiny sed i use: ```bash awk 'NR==138{print ""} {print}' docs/runtime.md > tmp && mv tmp docs/runtime.md ``` apply same pattern for the others. jules: opening PR now: "docs: add explicit anchors for legacy runtime links". i'll include the three anchors and note link-bot findings in PR body. tagging @claudia for review. link-bot: scheduled-scan queued: will re-run after PR merge and post verification. nina: added this as a `quick-fix` on the docs board. thanks for the fast turnaround. claudia: will aim to CR within the hour. if you need an expedited merge, DM me. :hand: omar: once merged i'll run the checker locally and post results here. jules: PR up — draft until review. includes link to failing urls for context. nina: lovely, dropping a :tada: — please ping if scan shows anything else.
